propositions: The code-review-verify spec emits verifications without decision polarity (FAIL/block), causing _verdict_decision to fall through to advisory for all cases regardless of gold label.
Gold-block case V-real-defect is scored advisory and guaranteed to miss on both arms because verifications presence cannot be interpreted as a block decision.
A naive fix mapping non-empty verifications to block would fix the recall miss but simultaneously mis-score gold-advisory case V-clean-rename as block, creating a false accept.
code-review-verify must be excluded from the parity corpus via a separate POLARITY_FREE_SOLVERS mechanism distinct from AGENTIC_SOLVERS to preserve the exclusion reason and prevent future collapse.
Exclusion reduces n_gold from 28 to 26 (still above MIN_GOLD_ITEMS threshold of 20) and raises bedrock recall to 1.0 without flipping any gating verdicts.
All acceptance criteria including test assertions for exclusion disjointness, offline re-scoring with zero model calls, and gate checks (lint, typecheck, config-read) are satisfied.
